title: 2025 Spring Semester Appreciation Gathering｜Ritsumeikan University Social Intelligence Laboratory

summary.lead: We held a Spring Semester Appreciation Gathering.
summary.place: Nonotori Ibaraki Tsubakino Honjin, Ibaraki City

overview: We held our 2025 Spring Semester Appreciation Gathering! It took place in Ibaraki, where we enjoyed a wonderful evening together to mark the end of the semester. While sharing hot pot dishes and drinks, we reflected on the spring semester and our activities. Everyone, regardless of grade, joined in lively conversations on many topics and had a great time. This spring semester was a productive one for both research and coursework. Let’s keep up the good work in the fall semester as well!
